mapper.select:
select mc.member_course_id, mc.course_id, mc.member_id, mc.teacher_id, mc.course_name, mc.course_price, mc.course_details, mc.image, mc.course_hour, mc.teacher_name, m.name as member_name, m.username as member_username from member_course mc left join member m on mc.member_id = m.member_id
and mc.course_name like concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
order by mc.member_course_id desc

select mc.member_course_id, mc.course_id, mc.member_id, mc.course_name, m.name as member_name, m.username as member_username, m.phone as member_phone from member_course mc left join member m on mc.member_id = m.member_id where mc.course_id = #{courseId} order by mc.member_course_id asc
